bronze_male.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Workout Tracker sport mastery avatar. Generate exactly ONE fictional male Rugby athlete for the Bronze tier. Polished premium semi-realistic stylised 3D game-skin illustration, credible for ages 10 through adult; crisp face, natural athletic proportions, well-defined hands and believable equipment. Original character, not a real athlete or celebrity. Character identity: medium brown skin, short textured black hair, brown eyes. Youth academy/developing athlete, approximately 12–14, modest practical kit, natural junior physique; no adult musculature or jewellery. Collection palette: cream and deep burgundy; gradually refined gold edging; midnight navy/gold champion kit; formal burgundy-accented navy. This tier's outfit below determines the current colours. Outfit: Simple junior burgundy shirt with cream trim, practical shorts and inexpensive boots. Equipment: Oval rugby ball without prominent American-football laces; rugby shirt, shorts, long socks and studded boots. No American-football helmets or shoulder pads. Award: None. Pose: Standing with the oval ball held securely against one hip. Square portrait. Entire head, hands, equipment and both feet visible, centred with 6–8% clear transparent margins. Athlete occupies roughly 80–88% of canvas height; trophies fit naturally inside the frame. Keep face and torso unobstructed. Match the rendering finish and proportions of the supplied style reference, but follow this tier's kit and award brief. Keep the corresponding male and female tier equal in prestige, award scale, kit quality and visual presence. Create a real transparent background with clean alpha edges. No words, lettering, numbers, brand or team logos, watermark, border, background scene, extra people, unrelated weapons, fantasy armour, wings, magic, neon aura or trophy clutter. Bronze has no award. Do not invent extra medals or accessories. No copied official trophy inscriptions. Preserve the same athlete's face, skin tone and hair identity within each variant across its eight-tier ladder, allowing the planned progression in age and presentation.

Sport-specific constraints: Replace the recolour-led direction of the first rugby batch with a kit-and-awards story. Use the existing portraits for rendering finish only; paired v2 must look like one athlete developing through each ladder. World Rugby player-of-the-year awards inspire the formal final stage; the trophy design is original.
Input images: Image 1 is Football Bronze as a rendering/framing reference only; Image 2 is legacy Rugby finish/equipment reference only. Create the new medium-brown-skinned junior Rugby boy with short textured black hair. Use burgundy kit, not the legacy brown kit, and a believable smooth oval rugby ball without laces. Keep both feet fully inside the canvas.
